The event of a `beforeX` listener of a UI, which can refuse the change it announces.

## Method details

<a id="UIChangeEvent-Pre-method-cancel"></a>

### cancel

`void cancel()` 

Refuses the change: the value stays, and the `onX` event does not fire.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` in a `MONITOR` listener.

<a id="UIChangeEvent-Pre-method-isCancelled"></a>

### isCancelled

`boolean isCancelled()` 

Returns `true` once a listener refused the change.
